reconstruction_summary: Re-ran V4: imported triage.linear_st_yaw_rate with saved Cα=(1.5e5,1.5e5), applied per-segment straight-line yaw-bias to form V3 prediction, then triage.residual_learner_loo (Ridge α=1, LOO) on V3 residuals across all 545 canonical Ford segments.
notes: Favourite = V4 (declared best in REPORT: 'Recovers everything V2+V3 lost and pushes overall below V1'). Reconstructed by importing agent's triage module and re-running V3 (linear single-track with saved Cα=1.5e5 N/rad both axles + per-segment straight-line yaw-bias) plus V4 Ridge residual learner with leave-one-segment-out CV on features [v,|a_y|,|delta|,sign(ddelta)]. V3 Cα coefficients are from agent's saved out/ladder_results.json (L-BFGS-B returned the initial guess — flat loss surface). Per-platform L, l_f, l_r, m, I_z used (Mach-E and F-150). LOO Ridge applied across full 545-segment canonical set (the agent's procedure rather than fixed coefficients, since LOO doesn't yield a single saved model).
